title: 污水處理廠臭氣生物濾床~Odor biofilters for wastewater plants
focus: 把污水臭氣收集、傳質、生物反應與床層維護串成完整流程~Connect wastewater odour collection, mass transfer, biodegradation and bed maintenance
summary: 本課以「把污水臭氣收集、傳質、生物反應與床層維護串成完整流程」為主軸，依序處理臭味源與收集邊界、入口濃度與污染負荷、生物膜傳質與反應、消除容量與去除百分比、變動負荷與重新評估。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Connect wastewater odour collection, mass transfer, biodegradation and bed maintenance, progressing through Odour sources and collection boundary, Inlet concentration and contaminant loading, Biofilm mass transfer and reaction, Elimination capacity and percent removal, Variable loading and reassessment. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 臭味源與收集邊界~Odour sources and collection boundary
units.mechanism: 在進水、污泥儲存與脫水區分別標記臭氣源，先確認是否有效收集再討論末端處理率。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Mark odour sources at inlet works, sludge storage and dewatering and establish capture before interpreting downstream removal. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「臭味源與收集邊界」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Odour sources and collection boundary, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「臭味源與收集邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Odour sources and collection boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 集氣管與抽風需求~Collection ducts and blower demand
units.mechanism: 分開罩口、管路與床層壓降，風量過少可能漏收，過大則增加負荷與耗能。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。~Separate hood, duct and bed pressure losses; low flow may lose capture while excessive flow adds load and energy. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
units.verify: 針對「集氣管與抽風需求」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Collection ducts and blower demand, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「集氣管與抽風需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Collection ducts and blower demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 風機功率只與風量有關，與管路阻力無關。~Fan power depends only on flow and not on duct resistance.
units.practice: 只將 Δp 改成 1800 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 4.5 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Δp to 1800 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 4.5 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 入口濃度與污染負荷~Inlet concentration and contaminant loading
units.mechanism: 依物種配對氣量與濃度，臭味感受不能直接由單一化合物的質量濃度完整描述。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Pair species-specific concentration with flow; one compound mass concentration cannot fully describe perceived odour. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「入口濃度與污染負荷」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Inlet concentration and contaminant loading, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「入口濃度與污染負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Inlet concentration and contaminant loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 空床停留時間~Empty-bed residence time
units.mechanism: 先以總床體積計算 EBRT，再檢查氣體是否均勻穿床；它不等於每個分子的實際孔隙時間。 空床停留時間用總床體積與氣量定義，與實際孔隙停留時間不同。~Calculate EBRT from total bed volume, then check flow distribution; it does not equal every molecule’s actual pore residence. Empty-bed residence time uses total bed volume and flow and differs from actual pore-gas residence.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：空床體積 V=60 m³；氣量 Q=3600 m³/h。公式 EBRT=V/Q*3600，計算得 60 s。適用邊界：平均氣流與固定床體積，不包含孔隙率、短流或反應動力學。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Empty-bed volume V=60 m³; gas flow Q=3600 m³/h. Formula EBRT=V/Q*3600 gives 60 s. Applicability: Mean gas flow and fixed bed volume without porosity, bypass or kinetics.
units.verify: 針對「空床停留時間」，量各分區氣量、壓降和水分，檢查是否有未利用床區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Empty-bed residence time, Measure zone flows, pressure drops and moisture to identify unused bed regions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 平均 EBRT 足夠仍可能因短流讓部分氣體未被處理。 在「空床停留時間」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Adequate mean EBRT can coexist with untreated gas short-circuiting. Mark where this error can enter the Empty-bed residence time flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 空床停留時間就是每個氣體分子在孔隙中的實際時間。~EBRT equals the actual pore residence time of every gas molecule.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 4500 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變成 48 s。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 4500 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 60 to 48 s. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 生物膜傳質與反應~Biofilm mass transfer and reaction
units.mechanism: 污染物先由氣相移入濕潤生物膜再被利用，教學衰減常數整合多重作用，不能直接視為單一菌種速率。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。~Contaminants transfer from gas into moist biofilm before utilization; a teaching decay constant combines effects and is not a species-specific rate. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
units.verify: 針對「生物膜傳質與反應」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Biofilm mass transfer and reaction, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「生物膜傳質與反應」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Biofilm mass transfer and reaction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 前兩點符合一階衰減就保證所有後續時間也符合。~Agreement with two early points guarantees first-order decay at all later times.
units.practice: 只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 水分與床材條件~Moisture and packing condition
units.mechanism: 床材太乾會限制生物作用，太濕可能堵塞孔隙；用濕乾質量記帳，不由單一平均值決定全床狀態。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。~Dry packing can limit biology while wet packing can obstruct pores; track wet and dry mass rather than inferring the whole bed from one mean. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
units.verify: 針對「水分與床材條件」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Moisture and packing condition, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「水分與床材條件」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and packing condition flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 濕樣減重多少就代表固體或污染物被去除多少。~Wet-mass reduction equals the mass of solids or contaminants removed.
units.practice: 只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only wet-basis moisture w to 0.40, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 700 to 600 kg dry solids. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 消除容量與去除百分比~Elimination capacity and percent removal
units.mechanism: 同時比較每床體積移除量與去除比例，判讀低濃度高去除率是否具有足夠負荷能力。 消除容量是每單位床體積每小時移除的質量，和百分比去除率回答不同問題。~Compare removal per bed volume with percentage removal to assess whether high removal at low concentration demonstrates sufficient capacity. Elimination capacity is mass removed per bed volume per hour and answers a different question from percentage removal.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣量 Q=1000 m³/h；入口 Cin=50 mg/m³；出口 Cout=10 mg/m³；床 V=20 m³。公式 EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000，計算得 2 g/(m³ bed·h)。適用邊界：同一化合物與氣體基準、穩態；不能以單一化合物代表整體嗅覺反應。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas Q=1000 m³/h; inlet Cin=50 mg/m³; outlet Cout=10 mg/m³; bed V=20 m³. Formula EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000 gives 2 g/(m³ bed·h). Applicability: Same compound and gas basis at steady state; one compound does not represent total perceived odour.
units.verify: 針對「消除容量與去除百分比」，同時量入口出口與氣量，並保存其他臭味物種及嗅覺評估的範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Elimination capacity and percent removal, Measure inlet, outlet and flow together and document other odorous species and the scope of odour assessment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 低進料濃度時高去除率不一定代表高處理負荷能力。 在「消除容量與去除百分比」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~High percentage removal at low inlet concentration does not establish high loading capacity. Mark where this error can enter the Elimination capacity and percent removal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 去除率與消除容量是同一個指標，只是單位不同。~Removal percentage and elimination capacity are the same metric with different units.
units.practice: 只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1.5 g/(m³ bed·h)。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1.5 g/(m³ bed·h). Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 壓降、壓實與氣流旁通~Pressure drop, compaction and bypass
units.mechanism: 將床層壓降和分區流量一起看；壓降降低可能代表旁通，也可能代表清理改善，須有其他證據。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。~Interpret bed pressure with zonal flow; lower pressure may indicate bypass or improved cleaning and needs corroboration. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
units.verify: 針對「壓降、壓實與氣流旁通」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Pressure drop, compaction and bypass, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「壓降、壓實與氣流旁通」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Pressure drop, compaction and bypass flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要差壓上升，就能確定濾材一定破損。~A higher differential pressure proves the filter medium is damaged.
units.practice: 只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 變動負荷與重新評估~Variable loading and reassessment
units.mechanism: 用暴雨進水或污泥作業的假想尖峰改變負荷，檢查排放質量、床體反應與嗅覺評估是否一致。 消除容量是每單位床體積每小時移除的質量，和百分比去除率回答不同問題。~Apply hypothetical peaks from storm inflow or sludge work and check consistency among emitted mass, bed response and odour assessment. Elimination capacity is mass removed per bed volume per hour and answers a different question from percentage removal.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣量 Q=1000 m³/h；入口 Cin=50 mg/m³；出口 Cout=10 mg/m³；床 V=20 m³。公式 EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000，計算得 2 g/(m³ bed·h)。適用邊界：同一化合物與氣體基準、穩態；不能以單一化合物代表整體嗅覺反應。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas Q=1000 m³/h; inlet Cin=50 mg/m³; outlet Cout=10 mg/m³; bed V=20 m³. Formula EC=Q*(Cin-Cout)/V/1000 gives 2 g/(m³ bed·h). Applicability: Same compound and gas basis at steady state; one compound does not represent total perceived odour.
units.verify: 針對「變動負荷與重新評估」，同時量入口出口與氣量，並保存其他臭味物種及嗅覺評估的範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Variable loading and reassessment, Measure inlet, outlet and flow together and document other odorous species and the scope of odour assessment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 低進料濃度時高去除率不一定代表高處理負荷能力。 在「變動負荷與重新評估」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~High percentage removal at low inlet concentration does not establish high loading capacity. Mark where this error can enter the Variable loading and reassessment flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 去除率與消除容量是同一個指標，只是單位不同。~Removal percentage and elimination capacity are the same metric with different units.
units.practice: 只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1.5 g/(m³ bed·h)。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1.5 g/(m³ bed·h). Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 維護紀錄與長期表現~Maintenance records and long-term performance
units.mechanism: 把床材更換、加濕故障、風機停機與周界氣味事件對時，設備可用不等於持續達到處理目的。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Align packing replacement, moisture faults, blower outages and boundary odour events; equipment availability does not establish continuous treatment performance. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「維護紀錄與長期表現」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Maintenance records and long-term performance, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「維護紀錄與長期表現」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Maintenance records and long-term performance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
